经过: 皇甫嵩破黄巾于广宗、下曲阳，张梁、张宝死（张角先已病死）。
text_en: Huangfu Song crushes the Yellow Turbans at Guangzong and Xiaquyang; Zhang Liang and Zhang Bao are killed (Zhang Jue has already died of illness).

经过: 兖州刺史刘岱杀东郡太守桥瑁。
text_en: Liu Dai, inspector of Yan Province, kills Qiao Mao, grand administrator of Dong Commandery.

经过: 袁绍胁韩馥让冀州。
title_en: Han Fu gives up Ji Province
text_en: Yuan Shao forces Han Fu to hand over Ji Province.

经过: 王允、吕布诛董卓。
text_en: Wang Yun and Lü Bu put Dong Zhuo to death.

经过: 青州黄巾入兖州，刘岱战死；曹操领兖州。
text_en: The Qing Province Yellow Turbans invade Yan Province and Liu Dai falls in battle; Cao Cao takes over Yan Province.

经过: 公孙瓒攻杀幽州牧刘虞。
text_en: Gongsun Zan attacks and kills Liu Yu, governor of You Province.

经过: 曹操破吕布、张邈；张邈投袁术途中为部下所杀。
text_en: Cao Cao defeats Lü Bu and Zhang Miao; Zhang Miao is killed by his own men on his way to Yuan Shu.

经过: 袁谭攻北海，孔融出奔。
text_en: Yuan Tan attacks Beihai and Kong Rong flees.

经过: 孙策取会稽，王朗败降。
text_en: Sun Ce takes Kuaiji; Wang Lang is defeated and surrenders.

经过: 裴茂率段煨等讨斩李傕。
text_en: Pei Mao leads Duan Wei and others against Li Jue and beheads him.

经过: 曹操围下邳，吕布被擒缢杀。
text_en: Cao Cao besieges Xiapi; Lü Bu is captured and strangled.

经过: 张杨为部将杨丑所杀；次年曹操取河内。
text_en: Zhang Yang is killed by his officer Yang Chou; the next year Cao Cao takes Henei.

经过: 袁绍破易京，公孙瓒自焚。
text_en: Yuan Shao storms Yijing and Gongsun Zan burns himself to death.

经过: 袁术众叛亲离，北投袁绍不成，呕血而死。
text_en: Deserted by his followers and unable to reach Yuan Shao in the north, Yuan Shu dies vomiting blood.

经过: 孙策取豫章，太守华歆迎降（刘繇先已病卒）。
text_en: Sun Ce takes Yuzhang and its grand administrator Hua Xin comes out to welcome him and surrenders (Liu Yao has already died of illness).

经过: 张绣用贾诩计率众降曹。
text_en: On Jia Xu's advice Zhang Xiu surrenders to Cao Cao with his army.

经过: 曹操破南皮，斩袁谭。
text_en: Cao Cao takes Nanpi and beheads Yuan Tan.

经过: 张燕率众十余万降曹。
text_en: Zhang Yan surrenders to Cao Cao with more than a hundred thousand followers.

经过: 袁尚、袁熙投辽东公孙康，被斩，袁氏亡。
text_en: Yuan Shang and Yuan Xi flee to Gongsun Kang in Liaodong and are beheaded; the Yuan family comes to an end.

经过: 曹操北征，白狼山斩蹋顿，三郡乌桓破。
text_en: Cao Cao marches north and kills Tadun at White Wolf Mountain; the Wuhuan of the three commanderies are broken.

经过: 孙权以步骘为交州刺史，斩苍梧太守吴巨（一说 211）。
text_en: Sun Quan appoints Bu Zhi inspector of Jiao Province, and Bu Zhi beheads Wu Ju, grand administrator of Cangwu (one account says 211).

经过: 刘备围成都，刘璋出降。
text_en: Liu Bei besieges Chengdu and Liu Zhang comes out to surrender.

经过: 夏侯渊破枹罕，斩「河首平汉王」宋建。
text_en: Xiahou Yuan takes Fuhan and beheads Song Jian, the self-styled King of the River's Head Who Pacifies Han.

经过: 曹操取汉中，张鲁降。
text_en: Cao Cao takes Hanzhong and Zhang Lu surrenders.

经过: 韩遂为部下所杀（一说病死），首级送曹操。
text_en: Han Sui is killed by his own men (another account says he died of illness), and his head is sent to Cao Cao.

经过: 单于呼厨泉入朝被留于邺，曹操分其众为五部。
title_en: Southern Xiongnu split into five divisions
text_en: Chanyu Huchuquan comes to court and is kept at Ye; Cao Cao divides his people into five divisions.

经过: 曹丕受禅，东汉亡。
text_en: Cao Pi receives the abdication, and the Eastern Han falls.

经过: 士燮卒，子士徽自立，吕岱诱杀之，士氏亡。
text_en: Shi Xie dies and his son Shi Hui sets himself up independently; Lü Dai lures him out and kills him, ending the Shi family's rule.

经过: 司马懿破襄平，斩公孙渊。
text_en: Sima Yi takes Xiangping and beheads Gongsun Yuan.

经过: 邓艾入成都，刘禅出降，蜀汉亡。
text_en: Deng Ai enters Chengdu and Liu Shan comes out to surrender; Shu Han falls.

经过: 司马炎受禅，曹魏亡。
text_en: Sima Yan receives the abdication, and Cao Wei falls.

经过: 王濬入建业，孙皓出降，吴亡。
text_en: Wang Jun enters Jianye and Sun Hao comes out to surrender; Wu falls.
